reviews.text: The staff was friendly, patient, and gentle with our dog, and the grooming was done with great care. My puppy came home looking adorable and feeling comfortable. I’ll definitely be back and highly recommend them!

Chloe' Girl came home looking and smelling absolutely beautiful! This was her first visit, and she's normally very anxious about grooming, but she was noticeably calmer than usual; barely any of her typical whining.
The groomer clearly picked up on her nerves and adjusted accordingly, using the walk-in dryer instead of the handheld one since Chloe's more comfortable that way.
Honestly, we felt like she got the princess treatment. Every staff member was very nice and professional. I called partway through just to check in, and they sent me a sweet video of her mid-dry, which put my mind completely at ease.
I also mentioned it was her birthday; they surprised us with a gorgeous, professional-looking birthday photo. That little extra touch meant so much💖
We've officially switched grooming salons! Chloe Girl has a new home for grooming from here on😀
If you’re near the Northeast Philadelphia area, give them a try. You will be happy with their services!
Thank you Lovely Pet Grooming & Beauty Salon for taking such good care of our Chloe’ Girl🥰
Sincerely,
Denise & Family😀
